/* ================================================================= */
/* type of ioctl macros                                              */
/* ================================================================= */
#define _QP0L_DEV_SOCKET      1               /* for socket          */
#define _QP0L_DEV_FILE        2               /* for  file  system   */


/* ================================================================= */
/* For use to create ioctl macros.                                   */
/* 't' is the device number for use to identify the type of ioctl    */
/*     macros.                                                       */
/* 'op' is the sequence number which is used to control the          */
/*      uniqueness of the ioctl macros.                              */
/* 'flag' is a reserved field.                                       */
/* ================================================================= */
#define _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(t, op, flag) \
           (((t)<<16) | (unsigned long)0 | (op) | (flag))


/* ================================================================= */
/* File system ioctl macros                                          */
/* ================================================================= */
#define FIONREAD    _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_FILE,  1, 0)
#define FIONBIO     _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_FILE,  2, 0)
#define FIOCCSID    _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_FILE, 13, 0)
                           /* The FIOCCSID command returns the CCSID
                              of the open instance and the object
                              CCSID in the storage pointed to by
                              the third parameter of the ioctl()
                              API                                @A6A*/

 /* Structure returned by FIOCCSID ioctl macro                   @A6A*/
 struct Qp0lFIOCCSID {
   int object_CCSID;   /* CCSID of the object                    @A6A*/
   int open_CCSID;     /* CCSID of the open instance             @A6A*/
 };                                                           /* @A6A*/

/* ================================================================= */
/* Socket ioctl macros                                               */
/* ================================================================= */
#define SIOCATMARK     _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_SOCKET, 1,0)

                                                            /* @A8A*/
#define SIOCDELRT6  _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_SOCKET,31,0)
                                                            /* @A8A*/

#define FIOASYNC  _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_FILE,  3, 0)
                                                           /* @A1A */
#define FIOSETOWN  _QP0L_CREATE_UNIQUE_MASK(_QP0L_DEV_FILE,  9, 0)
                                                           /* @A1A */
